rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for accepting a claim, believing someone, or having confidence in someone.

example.jyutping: ngo5 soeng1 seon3 nei5 gong2 ge3 je5

rows.note: Use this instead of 相信 when “believe” means giving your opinion or saying what you think.

example.english: I believe it will rain today.
example.jyutping: ngo5 gok3 dak1 gam1 jat6 wui5 lok6 jyu5

rows.note: Use this for religious faith or for accepting that a god, spirit, ghost, or other entity exists.
Use this when “believe in” means approving of something or considering it right or desirable.

example.english: I believe this is the right approach.
example.jyutping: ngo5 zaan3 sing4 ni1 go3 zou6 faat3
